contexts.text: The internal worship (of the second Ancient Church) is Peleg (). AC 1240. AC 1242.

And begat Peleg () = a derivation from (the Church Eber). Peleg was a nation, so called from him as its father, by which is signified external worship. The reason Peleg, here, = external worship, follows from the series... thus from his derivation. In the preceding chapter there is another meaning from the signification of the name... because there, he, with his brother Joktan, represented that Church.
